name: Apply Trim Primer (Spray Method)
intent: Spot-prime knots in solid wood (only), then spray prime entire trim with airless. Spray is ~4x faster per LF than brush but requires the wall masking from the setup module to be in place.
doctrine: 375 LF/hr for spray prime is ~4x the brush rate (90 LF/hr) — the airless trim gun coats both faces and the profile in one pass. MDF edge seal and knot spot prime use the same brush rate (100 / 40) regardless of method because they're spot-application work with a small brush, not areas the airless can hit. The spray scenario must have wall masking installed first via MOD_SETUP_TRIM_WALL_MASK or overspray contaminates the walls.
